notes_list.title: Spearman: Two-Factor Theory (1927)
notes_list.basic_overview: Charles Spearman proposed the two-factor theory using factor analysis: intelligence has a general factor (g) and specific factors (s).
notes_list.extra_info_content: The general (g) factor influences all specific abilities (mechanical, verbal, spatial, numerical). Not 'fluid', 'crystallized' or 'practical' intelligence.

notes_list.title: Ramanathapuram-Rameswaram: No-Wire Section
notes_list.basic_overview: Near INS Parundu (naval air station, Uchipuli) the railway track passes close to the runway, so overhead wires were removed for about 220 m (flight-safety reason).
notes_list.extra_info_content: The pilot lowers the pantograph and the train crosses this 'no-wire section' by coasting on momentum (about 110 km/h entry speed), then raises the pantograph again. Source: a Google AI answer in your PDF, so verify once before exam use.
